newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian aerospace company opts for British workers.
newsitem.headline: Belgian aerospace company opts for British workers.

text.p: Belgian aerospace company Sonaca SA said on Tuesday it will employ 100 additional workers to meet an increase in orders, of which half will be cheaper British labour.
Belgian unions criticised Sonaca for its move to employ the 50 British technicians, noting that the company recently cut its Belgian workforce by 196 as part of a restructuring plan.
They appealed to Sonaca's board to reinstate some of the workers laid off since January 1996 after a planned merger with Belgian aerospace company Sabca fell through.
Sonaca, which is majority owned by Belgium's Walloon region, has received orders to supply parts for 160 aircraft in 1997 from 80 presently.
